tex_content.html:
With the preceding data and $J$ fixed, there is $\delta ''>0$ such that the same conclusion with error $\zeta /2$ holds if the component condition is weakened to \[ f(b)\le w_{f(a),a}(b)+\delta ''. \] \end{claim}
Proof

↗ claim:piecewise-domination-estimate \sketch Iterate the preceding error estimate. The finitely many additional errors are products of $\delta ''$ with bounded exponential factors, so choose $\delta ''$ small enough that their sum is below $\zeta /4$.

□

\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Limit of the curve-shrinking flows]

copy_context.title: deltaprime
copy_context.description:
\label{deltaprime}

With the preceding data and $J$ fixed, there is $\delta''>0$ such that the
same conclusion with error $\zeta/2$ holds if the component condition is
weakened to
\[
f(b)\le w_{f(a),a}(b)+\delta''.
\]
\end{claim}
